name: Sub-Froxel Temporal Jittering
definition: Jittering strategy for froxel-based rendering that offsets the sampling point only along the froxel's depth (camera forward direction) to reduce spatial complexity and improve temporal stability.
summary: Sub-Froxel Temporal Jittering offsets sampling along the depth axis to enable temporal supersampling, distinguishing itself by restricting movement to the z-axis to improve temporal stability.
